subject: High-latency impact — proposed service recovery offer and trial extension
messages:
From: Jake Morales <jake@clearcloud.ai>
To: Karthik Iyer <karthik@redwood.com>, Monica Patel <monica@redwood.com>
Cc: Naomi Feldman <naomi@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-11-12T09:18:00-08:00
Subject: High latency affecting nightly batch jobs

Hi Karthik / Monica,

We saw a sustained latency regression on our dedicated inference endpoints starting around 02:10 UTC on 2026-11-12 and lasting ~3.5 hours. Multiple nightly batch jobs timed out — roughly 180k tokens were retried overnight which blocked downstream ETL and caused missed SLAs with two of our customers.

Concrete impact:
- 03:00–05:30 UTC: avg latency for 1k-token calls spiked from ~350ms to ~1.8s.
- Several retry loops exhausted; 6 jobs moved to manual intervention.
- Estimated incremental cost from retries: ~$1,200; downstream SLA penalties under review.

We need:
1) a clear incident timeline and root cause summary
2) an offer for service credits or extension of our trial/commit to make ClearCloud whole for the operational disruption
3) confirmation that this won’t recur and any mitigation steps we can apply immediately

Please treat as high priority — this directly impacted our customers and our renewal conversation next month.

Thanks,
Jake
Jake Morales
Head of Platform Engineering
ClearCloud Analytics

From: Karthik Iyer <karthik@redwood.com>
To: Jake Morales <jake@clearcloud.ai>
Cc: Naomi Feldman <naomi@redwood.com>, Monica Patel <monica@redwood.com>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-11-12T11:05:00-08:00
Subject: Re: High latency affecting nightly batch jobs

Jake — thanks for the clear summary and for flagging the urgency. I’m escalating this immediately to our on-call support and ops leads; Rishi is looped in to run an initial postmortem and get you a timeline within the next 24 hours.

Immediate actions:
- Rishi: please prioritize collection of: per-instance metrics, scheduling windows, and any autoscaler events.
- Naomi / Monica: I want a short customer-facing remediation note prepared for ClearCloud and their C-suite (one pager).

On compensation: we’re prepared to make a service-recovery offer while we complete root-cause analysis. Tentative proposal (subject to Rishi’s confirmation): 50,000 token credit and a 30-day trial/usage extension for ClearCloud’s active projects. I will wait for support confirmation before sending formal wording.

Jake — we understand timing is tight with your renewal. I’ll follow up by EOD tomorrow with the incident timeline and formal comp offer.

Best,
Karthik Iyer
Head of Sales — Hosted & Dedicated
Redwood Inference

From: Rishi Malhotra <rishi@redwood.com>
To: Karthik Iyer <karthik@redwood.com>, Naomi Feldman <naomi@redwood.com>, Monica Patel <monica@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-11-13T08:30:00-08:00
Subject: Re: High latency affecting nightly batch jobs — initial findings and comp guidance

Team — quick summary from triage:
- Timeline: 02:08 UTC — autoscaler mis-throttled an older pool when a snapshot job kicked off; a faulty health-check misclassified warm-up instances as unhealthy, reducing available capacity by ~35% for ~3.3 hours.
- Root cause hypothesis: regression introduced in autoscaler rollback (config drift) during a config push earlier that morning.
- Mitigations completed: reverted config push, adjusted health-check thresholds, and temporarily pinned the pool to reserve capacity overnight.

Impact estimate: ~180k tokens retried (matches customer report). No customer data exposure.

Compensation recommendation for commercial/AM review:
- 60,000 token service credit applied to ClearCloud’s account (to cover retries + goodwill)
- 45-day trial/usage extension (instead of 30) given the business impact and to preserve renewal momentum
- One month of premium monitoring (no charge) and weekly check-ins for 6 weeks

Attachments: incident-timeline.csv (metrics + timestamps)

If Sales/legal approve, we can package the offer and send a DocuSign acceptance link.

— Rishi
Director, Support & Reliability
Redwood Inference

From: Karthik Iyer <karthik@redwood.com>
To: Jake Morales <jake@clearcloud.ai>
Cc: Naomi Feldman <naomi@redwood.com>, Monica Patel <monica@redwood.com>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-11-14T15:22:00-08:00
Subject: Service recovery offer and next steps — ClearCloud Analytics (CLD-4932)

Jake — thanks again for the patience while we investigated. Below is the formal service recovery offer we can put in writing today; Rishi’s team validated the timeline and impact.

Offer summary (formal):
- 60,000 token service credit applied to ClearCloud Analytics account CLD-4932 (usable against generation and embedding calls)
- 45-day extension to the current evaluation/usage window starting 2026-11-15
- One month of premium monitoring and weekly check-ins (no charge) for the next 6 weeks

Next steps:
1) Please review the attached proposed-comp-offer.pdf and confirm acceptance.
2) We’ll provide a DocuSign acceptance link (docusign-service-recovery-link.txt contains the short URL) — sign and we’ll apply credits within 48 hours.
3) Naomi will schedule the first monitoring call for next Tuesday; I’ve copied her to coordinate timing.

We’re sorry for the disruption and appreciate your partnership. Our engineering and reliability teams will produce a fuller RCA and publish it to the shared Drive folder (link below) once complete. If you’d like a deeper walkthrough with our infra leads, we can schedule that as well.

Attachments: proposed-comp-offer.pdf, incident-timeline.csv, docusign-service-recovery-link.txt

Best regards,
Karthik Iyer
Head of Sales — Hosted & Dedicated
